DIAGNOSIS READY: Hodgkin Lymphoma

The combination of massive lymphadenopathy (axillary, mediastinal, cervical), splenomegaly, elevated LDH, and classic "B-symptoms" strongly suggests a hematologic malignancy. Given the supraclavicular involvement and systemic symptoms, we must confirm the specific subtype. Are you currently experiencing any pain in your lymph nodes after drinking alcohol?
